notes: The opening 'if when' holds one more subordinator than the clause holds conjunctions; the waw takes 'if' and 'when' is added under rule 55's count. The unit's note names the competing single-rendering reading.
Two waws have no English of their own: the apodosis waw of וְתָקַע is unrepresented, since the one written 'and' stands before 'warn', which is the rendering of וְהִזְהִיר.
